named-query.name: StarredWeblog.getByUser&Weblog
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM StarredWeblog s WHERE s.user = ?1 AND s.weblog = ?2

named-query.name: StarredWeblog.getByUser
named-query.query: SELECT s FROM StarredWeblog s WHERE s.user = ?1

named-query.name: StarredWeblog.removeByUser
named-query.query: DELETE FROM StarredWeblog s WHERE s.user = ?1

named-query.name: StarredWeblog.removeByWeblog
named-query.query: DELETE FROM StarredWeblog s WHERE s.weblog = ?1

named-query.name: StarredWeblog.getStarredWeblogsByUserOrderByLatestEntry
named-query.query: SELECT s.weblog FROM StarredWeblog s WHERE s.user = ?1 ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(e.pubTime) FROM WeblogEntry e WHERE e.website = s.weblog) DESC NULLS LAST
